::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 26th [1865]  
**From:** Crookham  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 114
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)
Happening to have an excess of M.S. luggage, I am rather glad to send off an instalment of “the <u>[Chaplet of Pearls](cmy_books/cmybook_69.qmd)</u>” instead of packing it up. It threatens to be longer than the [Dove](cmy_books/cmybook_62.qmd), and there is a good deal more still to be written, and probably rewritten.

I believe I omitted to say that it would be the most convenient way to me if you could [pay](organizations/other_160.qmd) the £235, the balance of my account to my name at [Messrs Hoare](organizations/other_169.qmd)’s.

Yours very truly
C M Yonge
